original_target.title: Does mixing force exponential decay for smooth Anosov flows?

scope_comparison: Three-dimensional, contact and constant-curvature reparametrization results add hypotheses; neither discrete maps nor one special mixing example proves the universal smooth Anosov-flow assertion. The 2022 broad claim is withdrawn for a fatal lemma flaw.
